$comment: RFC-0042. One job application, start to send. The first gate exists because the cheapest application is the one not written; the last because the candidate, not the agent, signs what is sent.
name: apply
description: Take one job posting and one resume to an application ready to send — an honest fit check, a tailored resume and a cover letter — with the candidate deciding whether to apply before any writing, and confirming every claim is true before anything is sent. Use when the user wants to apply for a job, says "help me apply for this", or wants a resume and cover letter prepared for one posting.

stages.intent: Say honestly where the candidate stands against the posting, then let them decide whether this application is worth writing.
Rewrite the resume for this posting from what the candidate has done and nothing else.
Write the letter from the tailored resume, the posting and the candidate's own reason for wanting the job.
Strip what the machine left behind, then have the candidate confirm that every line in both documents is true and theirs.
